codex_research_progress_reached_at_valid.name: codex_research_progress_reached_at_valid
codex_research_progress_reached_at_valid.value:
("codex_research_progress"."score" = 0 AND "codex_research_progress"."score_reached_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("codex_research_progress"."score" > 0 AND "codex_research_progress"."score_reached_at" IS NOT NULL)

coupon_codes_redeemed_pair_check.name: coupon_codes_redeemed_pair_check
coupon_codes_redeemed_pair_check.value: ("coupon_codes"."redeemed_at" IS NULL AND "coupon_codes"."redeemed_by_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("coupon_codes"."redeemed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "coupon_codes"."redeemed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

guilds_color_active_idx.name: guilds_color_active_idx
guilds_color_active_idx.where: "guilds"."disbanded_at" is null and "guilds"."color" is not null

marketplace_buy_orders_v2_equip_criteria.name: marketplace_buy_orders_v2_equip_criteria_valid
marketplace_buy_orders_v2_equip_criteria.value: ("marketplace_buy_orders_v2"."kind" = 'equip' AND "marketplace_buy_orders_v2"."quantity_initial" = 1 AND "marketplace_buy_orders_v2"."min_power" IS NOT NULL AND "marketplace_buy_orders_v2"."min_power" >= 1 AND "marketplace_buy_orders_v2"."min_quality_pct" IS NOT NULL AND "marketplace_buy_orders_v2"."min_quality_pct" BETWEEN 0 AND 100) OR ("marketplace_buy_orders_v2"."kind" <> 'equip' AND "marketplace_buy_orders_v2"."min_power" IS NULL AND "marketplace_buy_orders_v2"."min_quality_pct" IS NULL)

listings_v2_bid_pair_check.name: listings_v2_bid_pair_check
listings_v2_bid_pair_check.value: ("marketplace_listings_v2"."highest_bid" IS NULL AND "marketplace_listings_v2"."highest_bidder_id" IS NULL) OR ("marketplace_listings_v2"."highest_bid" > 0 AND "marketplace_listings_v2"."highest_bidder_id" IS NOT NULL)

messages_channel_scope_check.name: messages_channel_scope_check
messages_channel_scope_check.value: ("messages"."channel" IN ('global', 'trade') AND "messages"."guild_id" IS NULL AND "messages"."room_id" IS NULL) OR ("messages"."channel" = 'guild' AND "messages"."guild_id" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."room_id" IS NULL) OR ("messages"."channel" = 'room' AND "messages"."guild_id" IS NULL AND "messages"."room_id" IS NOT NULL)
